label: Choice-cell determination laws, from the definitions
description: A placed diagnostic for 608a262d: an invariant explanans (the kind an existential PSR reason token can be) explains the realized range of outcomes and no contrast within it; explaining the actual selection of a contingent outcome requires an explanans level whose own cell is contingent and is not seen to by any invariant level. The standard is label-free (law 7): it sees cell partitions, not whether a level is called an adoption, an actualization or an exercise. Establishes no premise; it is one contrastive standard (determination), not a theory of explanation.
